## Matching decompilations and disassemblies

- [**2EZDecomp: matching decompilation of EZ2AC**](https://github.com/Roganis/2EZDecomp) - 2EZDecomp reconstructs C and C++ for an EZ2AC arcade rhythm game executable and compares compiled functions with reccmp. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/2ezdecomp-ez2ac-case/)</sub>
- [**3S Decomp: a byte-compared PS2 decompilation of Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike**](https://github.com/crowded-street/3s-decomp) - Decompiles the PlayStation 2 executable of Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike from Street Fighter Anniversary Collection into C that period Metrowerks and EE GCC compilers rebuild, then compares the rebuilt executable word by word with the user’s original. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sfiii-3rd-strike-ps2-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**AC1\_RE: Armored Core analysis and matching decompilation**](https://github.com/byroweb/AC1_RE) - AC1\_RE documents and analyzes the North American PlayStation release of Armored Core, including its executable, overlays, mission pipeline, text system and asset formats. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/ac1-re-case/)</sub>
- [**Agent decompilation: a byte-matching retrospective**](https://momo5502.com/posts/2026-10-09-game-decompilation/) - Maurice Heumann describes replacing plausible-looking agent output with compiler-based checks of reconstructed functions, relocations, data and types. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/agent-decompilation-oracle-case/)</sub>

- [**War Storm: reconstructing Sudden Strike II 2.2**](https://github.com/americusmaximus/WarStorm) - War Storm reconstructs source for Sudden Strike II 2.2 from the game's original binaries. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/war-storm-case/)</sub>

- [**WCW/nWo Thunder: a PlayStation decompilation**](https://github.com/martinbean/thunder) - WCW/nWo Thunder reconstructs source for the PlayStation game from a work-in-progress disassembly. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wcw-nwo-thunder-case/)</sub>
- [**Wii Sports: in-progress decompilation**](https://github.com/doldecomp/ogws) - ogws is a work in progress decompilation of Wii Sports. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wii-sports-ogws-case/)</sub>
- [**Wind Waker HD decompilation: functions verified against the recompiled Wii U game**](https://github.com/ZeldaWWHDDecomp/wwhd) - Decompiles the USA Wii U release of The Wind Waker HD function by function into readable C++ in zeldaret/tww’s style, and verifies each function by running it beside the original, statically recompiled from the user’s own copy, comparing return values, memory writes and calls on generated and recorded inputs, with coverage and mutation checks. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wind-waker-hd-decomp-case/)</sub>
